#include <tunables/global>

# Custom AppArmor profile for the Airlock Connector add-on. Tighter than the
# Supervisor's auto-generated default: it confines the connector + frpc binaries
# into a child profile that may touch only /data and the network, and denies
# mount, ptrace, raw capabilities and access to host paths. The profile name MUST
# equal the add-on slug (airlock_connector) so the Supervisor loads it.
#
# ENFORCE mode. If the add-on fails to start after an update, AppArmor is likely
# blocking a path this profile didn't anticipate. On Home Assistant OS, read the
# HOST log for the denial — Settings -> System -> Logs -> Source: Host (or
# `ha host logs`) — looking for apparmor="DENIED" profile="airlock_connector" and
# the blocked operation/name. Add an allow rule for it, or temporarily add
# `complain` back to BOTH profile flags below (loads but enforces nothing) while
# iterating, then remove it again.
profile airlock_connector flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {
  #include <abstractions/base>

  # No raw capabilities are needed; deny them explicitly (defense in depth).
  deny capability,
  deny mount,
  deny umount,
  deny ptrace,

  file,
  signal (send) set=(kill,term,int,hup,cont),

  # S6-Overlay (PID 1 from the base image; init: false in config.yaml).
  /init ix,
  /bin/** ix,
  /usr/bin/** ix,
  /run/{s6,s6-rc*,service}/** ix,
  /package/** ix,
  /command/** ix,
  /etc/s6-overlay/** rix,
  /etc/services.d/** rwix,
  /etc/cont-init.d/** rwix,
  /etc/cont-finish.d/** rwix,
  /run/{,**} rwk,
  /dev/tty rw,

  # Bashio (run.sh is `#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bashio`).
  /usr/lib/bashio/** ix,
  /tmp/** rwk,

  # The add-on options and any other add-on files.
  /data/** rw,
  /run.sh r,

  # Hand the long-running binaries their own confined profile.
  /usr/local/bin/airlock-connector cx -> airlock-connector,
  /usr/local/bin/frpc cx -> airlock-connector,

  profile airlock-connector flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {
    #include <abstractions/base>
    #include <abstractions/nameservice>
    #include <abstractions/ssl_certs>

    # Receive shutdown signals from S6-Overlay.
    signal (receive) peer=*_airlock_connector,

    deny capability,
    deny mount,
    deny ptrace,

    # Outbound TLS to the Airlock edge; no listening sockets are opened.
    network inet stream,
    network inet6 stream,

    # Persistent state: key, cert, CA and the rendered frpc.toml all live here.
    /data/** rwk,

    # The two static binaries; the connector execs frpc as a child in this profile.
    /usr/local/bin/airlock-connector r,
    /usr/local/bin/frpc rix,

    # Read-only system bits needed at runtime.
    /etc/passwd r,
    /etc/group r,
    /etc/nsswitch.conf r,
    /etc/resolv.conf r,
    /etc/ssl/** r,
    /tmp/** rwk,
  }
}
